# VT: sp2 neighbor of VL bonded to quaternary tether C
nbs = [n.GetIdx() for n in mh.GetAtomWithIdx(VL).GetNeighbors() if n.GetIdx() in ringC]

Cq_tether = [a.GetIdx() for a in mh.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=="C" and a.GetDegree()==4 and a.GetTotalNumHs()==0
             and any((n.GetIdx() in ringC) for n in a.GetNeighbors())][0]

# Embed with distance bounds to mimic the metal pocket
bm = rdDistGeom.GetMoleculeBoundsMatrix(molH)
def setb(i,j,lo,hi):
